messages.content:
Select the shared shell and remove the duplicate local display and row declarations.

```tsx
<section data-grid="shell" className={`data-table-wrapper ${className}`}>
```

```css
.data-table-wrapper { height: 100%; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; gap: .75rem; color: #334155; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }
```

The shared grid now owns display and row tracks. The component class and supplied className remain, along with unrelated wrapper declarations. Existing header/main/footer area markers remain compatible with the shared layout. Static checks confirm only the intended changes; rendered layout has not been tested.

reason: Use the project shared shell grid as the layout owner instead of duplicating its definition in component CSS.
